description: E18 Perceiver AR v2 MAIN run, stage 1 (AWS H100, <600M params, seq 32k->256k with batch_packing_mode=pack). Nemotron-first (user decision 2026-09-07): web = Nemotron-CC-v2.1 (High-Quality + Medium-High-Quality organic, capped HQ-Synthetic, translated, DQA); code = Nemotron-Pretraining-Code-v1 Synthetic-Code (real-code Nemotron-CC-Code-v1 access requested for Meridian21Lab, pending); math = Nemotron-CC-Math-v1 4plus + Specialized-v1 Math-Textbooks; STEM/QA = Specialized-v1 RQA, STEM-SFT, Wiki-Rewrite + Specialized-v1.2 Fact-Seeking; a small SFT-v1 General slice. The ONLY non-Nemotron sources are the long-document tier (FinePDFs, PG-19): the Nemotron family has no book/PDF-length documents and the long-context stages need them (PG-19 is also the paper-parity eval). Weights are per ROW (HF interleave), solved from `token_share_targets` with assumed mean row lengths; re-check with scripts/manifest_token_stats.py after pretokenization. Shard caps size the pool to ~350B tokens; the AWS plan fixes TARGET_TOKENS. Licences: Nemotron-CC/Code/Math/SFT = NVIDIA Data Agreement for Model Training (accepted on the Hub for Meridian21Lab; synthetic subsets carry Qwen/DeepSeek/Phi-4 pass-through terms); Specialized-v1/v1.2 = CC-BY-4.0; ClimbMix/ClimbLab excluded (CC-BY-NC). Gated repos need HF_TOKEN with approved access.

long_context_policy.notes: Packing (batch_packing_mode=pack) makes every training sequence full-length; FinePDFs, PG-19 and math textbooks supply the genuine >8k dependencies. Remove PG-19 test/validation books before any published PG-19 number.

token_share_targets.pending_swap: when nvidia/Nemotron-CC-Code-v1 access is approved: add source {name: nemotron_cc_code_v1, hf_id: nvidia/Nemotron-CC-Code-v1, subset: data, max_shards: 60} and split the 0.10 code share 0.07 real / 0.03 synthetic

sources.name: nemotron_cc_v21_hq
sources.notes: All 20 shards (~26B tokens, ~1.5M rows/shard). Organic Common Crawl, top quality bucket.

sources.name: nemotron_cc_v21_hq_synth
sources.notes: 40 of 86 shards (~43B tokens). Rephrased / QA-style synthetic web; capped so organic text dominates.

sources.name: nemotron_code_v1_synthetic
sources.notes: 80 of 316 files (~28B tokens; 222 GB total, ~1M rows/file). Nemotron synthetic code (code + explanations). Nemotron-Code-Metadata (repo/commit/path pointers only) is not usable without a GitHub fetch.

sources.name: nemotron_cc_math_4plus
sources.notes: All 46 files of the 4plus quality tier (~62 GB). Math web pages with LaTeX preserved (auto-gated, accessible).

sources.name: nemotron_math_textbooks
sources.notes: All 13 shards (~25B tokens, CC-BY-4.0). Long coherent math rows.

sources.name: nemotron_stem_sft
sources.notes: 30 of 104 shards (CC-BY-4.0). STEM Q/A in plain text; no chat template.

sources.name: nemotron_wiki_rewrite
sources.notes: All 7 shards (CC-BY-SA per the feasibility note; verify the per-row license column before release).

sources.name: nemotron_fact_seeking
sources.notes: 10 of 72 shards (CC-BY-4.0). Very short factual rows (~300 tokens) — hence the high row weight for a 1% token share.

sources.name: nemotron_sft_general
sources.notes: 20 of 68 shards (~7B tokens). Instruction-style text used as plain pretraining text (Nemotron-Nano late-phase practice); small share.

sources.name: finepdfs_100BT
sources.notes: NON-Nemotron (long-document tier): 60 of 100 shards (~60B tokens), ODC-By. Shards validated after download.

sources.name: pg19
sources.notes: NON-Nemotron (long-document tier + paper-parity eval): all ~28k books (~3B tokens), Apache-2.0 / public domain. Per-ROW weight 0.0007 ≈ 4% of tokens. Decontaminate against PG-19 test/validation before reporting.
